messages.subject: LOD score permutation too high?
parts:
Hi,

I am running permutations for scantwo, I have about 250 RILs, and chromosomes of around 500 cM. My LODfull score after 2000 permutations was around 14, I looked at the LOD distribution and saw that it was not unimodal, so I removed outlier individuals and re-ran everything. Now I am getting LODfull of 10.5 (at 5%) and 10 (at 10%), the distribution of LODfull scores now is unimodal. Does it seem too high? Is there any intuition of how high LODfull permutations should be?

--
Tiago da Silva Ribeiro
Ph.D. Candidate
Pool Lab
Department of Integrative Biology, UW-Madison
Laboratory of Genetics, UW-Madison

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: LOD score permutation too high?
parts:
Significance thresholds for two-dimensional scan can be large. They depend principally on genome size (which is greatly expanded in RILs) and then on type of cross, analysis method, and density of markers. Also some influence from pattern of missing genotype data, the phenotype distribution, and sample size.

karl
